alternate_archive_scope: Official NuGet package, used by the prepare script only when the release archive is unreachable. Its win-x64 runtime libraries, LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt are byte-identical to the release archive; the script pins all four files individually.
headers: Unmodified public C/C++ headers from the official release archive
runtime: Loaded from explicit application assets only; no global installation or downloads at runtime
